A document changed in the same pull request as the behaviour it describes stays in step with the code; one kept elsewhere and updated later drifts until readers stop trusting it; a reviewer can ask for a missing doc change like a missing test.
An outdated document misleads a reader who trusts it, while a reader with no document knows to check the code or ask; a document update written later has to compete with the next feature for time.
At stage-1 the cancel endpoint is PATCH /api/v1/orders/{id}/cancel, and STAGE.md@stage-1 lists it among the order endpoints.
Under the Definition of Done the cancel change would not count as done until the API documentation was updated, and a reviewer checking the list could ask for it before the merge.
git show <tag>:<path>, e.g. git show stage-1:STAGE.md, prints the file's content as it is at that tag.
